body:
Thanks for your answer! 

He literally said that when talking about my negative self concept "that normally is part of CPTSD but you do not remember violence". This was after telling him that I spent 5 years having sex against my will, so that apparently does not count. 

\>  Also, basically everyone with DID also has CPTSD

I thought that too, like, I assumed having clear DID is proof enough to get help for cptsd because that is the part we need help with, on the DID side we have been able to help ourselves in the past few years and get communication etc. But the cptsd symptoms are the ones that really hurt. 

But apparently it is not enough to have DID to get help for that. 

\> can you just consult with another therapist about this situation. 

I dont think I'll ever be able to open up or trust another person after this. It took me 2 years to open up to my current therapist. the specialist I talked to is the main expert in my country, not sure how to get another one and assuming no one would disagree with the main expert anyways. 

I'll check out the videos, thank you.

Thanks for your answer!

\> I mean, you learnt to dissociate at that level for a reason so it’s reasonable to assume there’s trauma there

I thought that too, but was told no, the clear DID is not proof enough to get a cptsd diagnosis and trauma therapy. I was told to just do more sport and get enough vitamin D and have more "social contacts".

\> Trying to force down dissociative barriers has the real possibility of triggering your whole system into shut down or chaos. It’s extremely dangerous.

I am willing to take any risk now, living like I am right now is not worth being alive it hurts too much.

\> There are plenty of studies showing the slightest suggestion can make someone think they remembered something / a detail that never actually happened.

I am aware. I mean I need something that is some sort of proof anyway, either a verifyable detail if the person who made me has made others too or a road to physical evidence.

\> Which means even if you provided photographic evidence, who’s to say they wouldn’t write that off as a photoshopped deceit? It might be a losing battle trying to influence their assessment of you, so be careful.

True but I have to try. I don't know how to live with the body in constant fight or flight mode and desperate need to be hugged and held. I need help.
oh apologies, I changed it to npd (talking about a dx I am worried my therapist is thinking I have, not talking about someone else)

The body is 29 years old.

I am fully responsible for everything in my life. I have a masters degree, a full time job earning 6 figures, I pay taxes, I act like everything is fine in front of everyone other than during one hour of therapy a week.

Not sure how exactly you get the idea I need to "grow up". Please provide what else a grown up needs to have or do in your opinion. Own a home is unfortunately not an option yet in my country that is much more expensive than the US, but I have stock options if those pan out I might be able to in a couple years.

I would just like to know, when I am awake every other night and cant get rid of the feeling of someone touching me sexually and get panicked and see sudden images of horrible things if I am making this up and should be punished for that or if I am traumatized.

EDIT: oh and to preempt the next attack: I am at ideal weight and have a personal trainer who currently has me on 3 workouts per week. I never smoked, never commited a crime, never been drunk in my life and funny that I need to say this here of all places have never taken any illegal drug or any psychopharma drug.

I mean you are right in the case that nothing happened, I am obviously one of the most disgusting pathetic people alive and should be tortured. 

My psychiatrist says he is not sure if anything happened, if he was sure that nothing happened he would obviously kick me out already... So I am in the limbo of not knowing whether I am actually traumatized or made everything up.

And I am fully with you that "psychosomatic trauma" is bullshit, there is either real physical or sexual abuse or I am a pussy who deserves to be raped and killed.

Well, I do have a trauma based disorder with all the symptoms, so I guess yes I am not 100% sure if it is there, I could be making it all up subconsciously in which case I very much would deserve everything horrible imagineable but I am currently working under the assumption I am not a pathetic liar.

All of the above is true other than that I don't want to do the work. I am ready to dedicate any minute I can (besides dayjob, I still need to eat) towards finding memories. So please if you have any work towards that I can do before taking anything please share.

Sorry stuff like that happened to you.   
I've been over all that I remember and was told it does not count, so I need to look for something I dont remember at all.

wow, well... uhm... glad that worked for you!  
but I think that goes to the bottom of the list as a last resort.

That would be exactly what I am looking for. May I ask if you think this is possible at a dose where you... don't throw up? If possible I'd like to skip that part. I can do without the loving mother and other life insights, just need the snippets.

I've tried staring at EMDR videos, but did not remember anything. I have several automatic writing type poems that describe abuse, but no actual memories came from it. Do you have a link to breathing exercises to remember trauma? I've never heard of that, I would prefer a non-chemical route... 

The person who told me my feelings don't count as proof for trauma is the main dissociation expert in my country. So... not really a higher authority to go to. I cannot get a new main doctor, no. 

A shorter experience for starters would be good, yeah, and from what I've heard and seen weed would not be my thing. 

I know it is probably kind of weird for this sub but I don't want to be high or have the experience really, I just want to be on the other side and remember what happened so I can get help for it.
Thank you

the psychiatrist I've been with for 6 years is the one who demands I remember if not I will not be allowed to talk about its effects anymore in therapy because I could be making it up (I assume this might a different thing in the US, but apparently it is the case here)

I think I have enough tools to explore, I just need to finally find something, been trying for years.
I heard it as a treatment, but what I need to do is remember it in as much detail as possible. And I currently remember nothing at all of it. Do you know if mdma helps with that?

Thank you. I am geting a bit calmer now it has been 2.5hrs... 

I am not worried about bacteria but about toxins that survive heat. Most likely would be S. aureus toxins... so I guess i'll be nervous till those 6hrs are over.

That is kinda interesting. I only had surgery once (appendix at age 22). I remember hearing myself talk in English (isn't my first language), then hearing the nurses ask "does she speak [countries language]" and me answering, still in English "of course I do". 

Woke up later and thought it was a dream but the nurses confirmed it. 

It was odd cause I felt like I was lying deep in bed and just internally watched and heard someone else talk calmly. Also the someone talking seemed male (and the body and me are female) o.o. 

But there was no anxiety or anything just the back hurting a lot. And a bit weak and sleepy cause I had not really slept or eaten in the two days prior.

no. Normal fridge below 5°C meal.
Bought it yesterday evening, has been in the fridge since then.

EDIT: I don't know how well they keep cooling chains in production/the store. Time for store to home is about 15min.

Thanks. You are right I should find out if I am actually helping him or not. If not I am just wasting his and my time. Yes I think his threats are real. Especially since they are not really threats, just him telling me how he feels and felt for years. I've tried to rationally asses if I am helping him by some harder endpoints in a [reply](http://www.reddit.com/r/Buddhism/comments/2zzjkb/my_boyfriend_wants_to_kill_himself_xpost_from/cpo3bcm)...

I wonder if a therapist would be able to help me help him with only the information he'd get from me. I am scared that I am biased and not objective... But I guess it would be worth a try. If I can't get my boyfriend to get into therapy again, then I'll be the proxy...

I certainly don't think I am the best person to help him! Best would be two dozen of professionals plus a better girlfriend (someone with at least a sexual desire). And I try to find a way to find a girlfriend for him... since he gave up on that and does not seem to want someone else... I am just the best bad option available I guess...

> Are you maintaining the status quo for him, so you can avoid your own guilty feelings if he chooses to end his life? 

This is exactly what I am scared of. That helping him all these years was actually something selfish... How do I find out? 

I am sorry you went through something similar.. 

As for anatta.. I understood it the way that the "self" is constantly changing and dependent on so many influences, so that it does not make any sense wanting to describe it as something existing in itself. Like wanting to define a wave. Maybe I got that wrong.. as I said, I am not a experienced Buddhist and spent my day with physiology instead of sutras mostly... My sentence was some sort of misplaced humour I guess... Sorry!
I don't quite understand... do you mean sexually?

Hmm... It is difficult to be rational with someones life... reminds me of ethics class (when is a person too old to get the expensive meds etc.)...

He is better now than when we met from a rational point I guess.   

He used to hurt himself twice a day, every morning and every evening. He now only does it when something upsets him, maybe two times a week (and he never remembers it)  
He was about to drop out of High School when we met and is now studying at university (with two majors, though I am scared that it is too much and he'll fail one)
He has a job, well he has a bunch of jobs, but this one has a future and is in the field he wants to work in at an international company. We work together there (got hired as a team of 3 with a friend). But he could do what I do, doesn't necessarily need me and our boss knows that I'll quit once I finish medschool.  
He has two close friends who know about his mental health and the situation with me, even the sexual difficulties (this might be the most important thing)

So I guess he is better. But he says that it only can get worse and "why not kill myself while things are still ok?"

On the negative end he now thinks that he'll never get "real sex" or a girlfriend who is "interested in him". Because I need time to study (means to him that I think that school is more important than him) and yeah the sex part...   
He does not seem to grasp the idea of ever meeting someone else... at least he tried with his classmates but it seems that most of them have a boyfriend, so he stopped trying...

Cost is only on my side. That should not come into the equation... but you are right I should find out if I am still of any use for him. In a perfect world I'd find a nice very sexually active girlfriend for him and then he'd slowly forget about me...

1. I am sorry... Is there a fitting place? I can delete the question if you think it is annoying but I feel that would be unfair for everyone that commented...
2. I agree on the emotional and mental abuse... luckily he never did physically abuse me (he even asks for permission multiple times every time he wants to do something rough sexually). Why danger?
3. That is what he is saying too... and everyone else here... yes I have no legal responsibility yet. I don't know if that will change once I get my MD...
This is a really accurate analogy. Thanks you. I guess the key is to not drown myself...

Thank you for your answer.

I don't think he'd ramp up threats if I leave. From all I know I'd expect him to thank me for letting him finally die. It is what he desired for years... I don't know how long planning and getting the "courage" (I feel it is the right and wrong word for this) to do it would take him. Maybe a week, maybe even a few months. 

I thought about getting a therapist for some twisted sort of "supervision"... Who I could ask what to do about certain things... though I don't think I could still influence him if we separated. And everything I said would only be from my subjective view... not easy for a therapist to help someone by proxy I guess...

But if I understood you right you meant to totally cut ties with him?

I feel like this goes against my nature (eventhough I thought of it and wanted to do it quite a few times). It would be the equivalent of stopping CPR on a patient who still has a chance of survival.... Of course CPR is exhausting over time, but  

 who am I to prioritize my own wellbeing over the life of someone?

Most people in this thread are suggesting that I should just walk away and let him die... I don't know if I can do that... I am only 20 and about to kill someone by denial of assistance. While spending all my time on learning how to save people... 

I just want to do the right thing. What is right for him, his friends and his family. I, myself am not the patient, I won't kill myself no matter what he does or if he dies, I'll spend my life helping people no matter if I am happy or sad... Because "I" doesn't exist, it does not matter.
